scoreDescription: Score = min(100, citations / 1000.0 + 8 × prominence × max(0, 1 − age in months / 24)). Prominence uses a sourced company affiliation, exact corporate author, or curated author match, whichever is higher; they do not stack. Unknown citations remain unknown; a reputation-only score is labeled provisional. Recent-paper cutoff: 4, with at least one verified citation or curated prerequisite connection to another visible paper. Older established papers are retained; filtered papers stay hidden until they qualify.
